title: Grateful Dead Live at Vanderbilt University on 1972-10-21

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a bass‑forward, slightly unbalanced mix captures a high‑energy Vanderbilt show highlighted by a soaring Morning Dew and an epic The Other One.
ai_review.review: The set shines thanks to a raw but clean second half where Truckin' morphs into a monster The Other One and culminates in a beautiful Morning Dew.  While the soundboard source is generally clear, reviewers note that Phil’s bass dominates the mix and vocals sit low, with occasional drop‑outs during Bird Song.

ai_rating.rationale: Average rating of 9 reviews is 4.33; most praise the performance and recording despite some mix imbalance, yielding a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall sound but heavily bass‑forward; Jerry’s guitar is high in the mix, vocals are low, and Bird Song suffers an equipment glitch. Some reviewers note the mix could be better balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set flows seamlessly from Truckin' into an extended jam, delivering a high‑impact climax with The Other One and Morning Dew; the overall pacing is praised as tight and inspiring.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar sits up in the mix, especially on the Truckin' > The Other One transition, with a tone many describe as nice and prominent.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is front‑and‑center, described as fat, round and “too hot in the mix”; multiple reviewers hail his 1972 playing as amazing.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann is noted as low in the mix; not a focus but mentioned as subdued.
